name: B10-0112/2026 (Renew) – World Cancer Day
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on World Cancer Day
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is not a law. It is the European Parliament's opinion, adopted to mark World Cancer Day on 4 February. It asks the European Commission and the Member States to keep funding and fully carry out Europe's Beating Cancer Plan, and to give health its own budget in the EU's 2028–2034 spending plans. It also calls for fairer access to cancer care, screening, medicines and clinical trials across the EU, and for cancer survivors to be protected from financial discrimination.

**Key points**

- The Parliament asks for a dedicated EU health budget and steady funding for cancer prevention, screening and care.
- It calls for fairer access to cancer medicines, cross-border care and trials, especially for rare and childhood cancers.
- It wants cancer survivors protected from financial discrimination, including a "right to be forgotten" in law.
